rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0001
rows.name:
They gave me the grand title of leader
of the Invidians here, but what I do
isn't all that impressive...

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Training the squad, monster
subjugations... and keeping
my men in line.

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0003
rows.name:
If we cause trouble with
the people where we're staying,
it burdens us and Adel-sama too.

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I'd love to quickly win some great
military achievement, but reality
doesn't work that neatly.

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Hey, don't tell Mars I've been
saying stuff like this. He'll
give me grief about it.

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0006
rows.name:
The other day, I got dragged into a
debate about what a leader should be.
It was a real headache.

rows.label: tlk70000051_02_msg0007
rows.name:
I got around it by serving my hidden
stash of food and drink until he was
completely plastered. Hahaha!
